==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Siuan Sanche]]}}

The [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]], [[Siuan Sanche]], paces in her study, waiting for [[Verin]] to arrive and pondering contingencies she has prepared for various events that might happen. [[Leane]], [[Keeper of the Chronicles]], comes into the room to announce Verin's arrival. To Leane's surprise, Siuan dismisses her to speak to Verin alone. Verin tells Siuan that [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] has proclaimed himself the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Siuan is pleased yet extremely anxious; she must assist the Dragon with Moiraine and Verin yet maintain the utmost secrecy. There are no more [[false Dragon]]s, Siuan says. There was a vision in the sky over the battlefields where both were winning and both were unhorsed and knocked unconscious. [[Mazrim Taim]] was captured and the other false Dragon was executed. Those events must have happened when Rand proclaimed himself and the [[Wheel of Time|Pattern]] decided it had no more need of false Dragons.

Verin takes the [[Horn of Valere]] out of a leather sack. Siuan is surprised to see it here. It was supposed to be with Rand but it was [[Mat]] that blew the Horn. Siuan asks whether [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] has changed the plan again but she is not to blame. Mat is sick and needs to be [[Healing|Healed]] and there is silent consideration on whether to Heal him in time, since he is now linked to the Horn and can be the only one to summon the [[Heroes of the Horn]] while he lives. The Amyrlin says they can hide the Horn for now. Verin says they need to deal with the [[Seanchan]] who use the [[One Power|Power]] as a weapon, confirming reports and rumors that Siuan has received. Siuan decides that since the Seanchan were chased away from [[Falme]], there are more important issues to deal with. They continue and Siuan tells Verin to give details on what [[Nynaeve]], [[Egwene]] and [[Elayne]] have been doing.
